subject: Invitation to Our Annual Company Dinner
body: Dear Team, I am excited to extend an invitation to our annual company dinner on Friday, December 10th, at 7:00 PM. This year, we will be celebrating our achievements and looking forward to the upcoming projects. The dinner will be held at the Grand Ballroom and will include a gourmet meal, entertainment, and awards ceremony. Please RSVP by November 30th. We look forward to celebrating with you all. Best regards, [Sender's Name]
